title: Exit Pass
tagline: What if grocery checkout were finished before you got to the front of the store?
stateNote: A working prototype that runs entirely on simulated store systems. It is not connected to any store.
problem: Scan-and-go apps still end at a register where someone audits the cart. Exit Pass explores targeted verification: you pay as you shop, and the exit check only looks at the one to three things that matter, so most trips skip it.
audience: Shoppers who hate lines, and store teams and builders who think about checkout, shrink and staffing.
contribution: It is my project. The shopper phone app, the register lane, the pass decision engine and the store radar are built from scratch against a simulated point-of-sale.
worksToday: A shopper flow with scanning, a running tax-included total and a live pass QR.
A register lane that recalls a paid basket and handles the check.
A store view that shows carts arriving, with simulated shoppers.
limitations: Point of sale, payments, cart sensors and store traffic are all simulated.
The README's security notes say what a production version would still need.
A hosted copy runs on my Vercel. Everything in it is still simulated.
